The [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] |first_appearance = [[Hexscape Event]] }} {{ScrollTOC|450px}} ==Description== The '''Children of Exo''' are the main villains of the [[Hexscape Event]] and [[Operation I.C.E Event]], and secondary antagonists of the [[Null & Void Event]]. They are a very devoted cult which follows and worships the enigmatic [[Lord Exo]], as indicated in their name. They believe that he can help them restore [[Trick or Threat Town]] back to its former glory.{{InlineQuote|When [[Trick or Threat Town]] was attacked, three brothers were saved by TDS from [[Lord Sinister]]. (...) [[Kronus]] found a [[God Cube|God]] Shard that was left behind, along with [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]. That’s when [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] promised that [[Lord Exo]] would rebuild the town, and the brothers could live together once more.|[[Kronus]]' description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} Their goal is to free [[Lord Exo]] from his prison within the [[God Cube]], obtaining as many shards as they can to do so, which they do actually achieveIn the [[Null & Void Event]].. They are in direct conflict with [[T.D.S. Organization]]—the protagonists of the game. ==Members== We are shown four main members who recur throughout the story: [[Titus|Titus Maximus]], [[Ramiel|Sentinel Ramiel]], [[Marcellus|Chief Marcellus]] and [[Kronus|Master Kronus]]. In [[Failed Gateway]], they also are shown to be in control of an army of pawns. No other members are shown to be part of the cult. The '''Children of Exo''' are shown to share association with other beings, such as the [[Frost Spirit]], whom they mind controlled into using its army to attack the [[T.D.S. Organization]], and the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], whom they share a strained relationship with. ===Titus=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Titus |image = Titusfailedgateway.jpg |aliases = Titus Maximus |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} [[Titus]], or [[Titus]] Maximus, is one of the members the '''Children of Exo''', and was the first cultist that the [[T.D.S. Organization]] fought against. He first appears during the [[Hexscape Event]], where he and the other cultists attempted to open a portal to the [[Nil Zone]] at [[Failed Gateway|Eclipsed Village]]. However, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] catches wind of their doings and puts a stop to them. [[Titus]] elects himself to hold off the agents so the portal can finish opening, and when it does, he and the agents are sucked through it. The portal's connection was faulty, however, and they enter the [[The Nightmare Realm|Hex Realm]] instead of the [[Nil Zone]], where [[Titus]] reconnects with the other cultists. When the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] is released, [[Titus]] is corrupted by the energy its fragment gave off, returning in [[Containment]] as [[Corrupted Titus]]. Again, he is defeated, but is not killed. [[Titus]] returns in the [[Null & Void Event]], being dragged into the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]] by the [[Null Guardian (Story)|Null Guardian]]. When he sees the agents, he plans to enact his revenge on them, but is smacked flying away into the air by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] for interrupting him.{{Clear}} ===Ramiel=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Ramiel |image = Ramielfailedgateway.jpg |aliases = Sentinel Ramiel
Ted the Janitor |relatives = [[Marcellus]] (Brother)
[[Kronus]] (Brother) |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/1731343/profile TinyChuke]Credited in the description of the following video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KGH-0-xgfGY }} [[Ramiel]], or Sentinel [[Ramiel]], is another member of the '''Children of Exo'''. He originates from [[Trick or Threat Town]] with his brothers [[Marcellus]] and [[Kronus]]. He made his first appearance in the [[Hexscape Event]], manning the terminal used to bridge a connection to the [[Nil Zone]]. When T.D.S. came to stop them, Ramiel and the other cultists fled the scene, later returning to the portal so they can meet up with [[Titus]] inside the [[The Nightmare Realm|Hex Realm]]. At the end of [[Containment]], [[Ramiel]] and [[Kronus]] swoop in to steal the [[God Cube]] fragment from the defeated [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] before returning escaping into the portal. [[Ramiel]] makes his second appearance in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], where he is revealed to have infiltrated the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. He corners the [[Commander]] and his troops at [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], using the [[Frost Spirit]]'s army to try and take them out for good. [[Professor V]] confronts [[Ramiel]] in the control room, but he manages to get away. [[Ramiel]] returns in the [[Null & Void Event]], appearing in [[Blind Faith]] where he and his brothers fight against the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] to free [[Lord Exo]]. But once [[Lord Exo]] manifests into his true form, the fate of [[Ramiel]] is left unknown. {{Clear}} ===Marcellus=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Marcellus |image = marcellushexscape.jpg |aliases = Chief Marcellus |relatives = [[Ramiel]] (Brother)
[[Kronus]] (Brother) |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/212661139/profile Trelakor] }} [[Marcellus]], or Chief [[Marcellus]], is the third member of the '''Children of Exo''' shown in the story. He is brothers with [[Ramiel]] and [[Kronus]]. He makes his initial appearance in the [[Hexscape Event]], being present when the cultists were attempting to establish a connection to the [[Nil Zone]]. When [[Titus]] held off the agents, [[Marcellus]] and the others fled the vicinity, later returning once the portal finished opening so they could meet up with [[Titus]] back in the [[The Nightmare Realm|Hex Realm]]. [[Marcellus]] made his next appearance in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], traveling into the [[Frost Realm]] along with [[Kronus]] to awaken the [[Frost Spirit]] from its castle so it can destroy the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. [[Marcellus]] makes his latest appearance in the [[Null & Void Event]], where he and his brothers show up in [[Blind Faith]] fighting against the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]. However, when [[Lord Exo]] incarnates into [[Kronus]]' body and kills the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], [[Marcellus]]' fate is left unknown.{{Clear}} ===Kronus=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Kronus |image = kronusoperationice.jpg |aliases = Master Kronus |relatives = [[Ramiel]] (Brother)
[[Marcellus]] (Brother) |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} [[Kronus]], or Master [[Kronus]], is the fourth and final member of the '''Children of Exo''' that is shown in the story. He is the brother of [[Ramiel]] and [[Marcellus]]. Through his title being master, him carrying the [[God Cube]] powered staff and him generally leading the other cultists, it can be concluded that he is the leader of the '''Children of Exo'''. [[Kronus]] first appeared in the story during the [[Hexscape Event]], being present when the cultists were attempting to open a portal to the [[Nil Zone]]. However, he, [[Ramiel]], and [[Marcellus]] ran off when the T.D.S. agents arrived, with [[Titus]] staying back to stall for time. [[Kronus]] and the others later met up with [[Titus]] inside the [[The Nightmare Realm|Hex Realm]], with him being mentioned by the [[Conserver]] as the "''hooded figure''" that disturbed the realm. [[Kronus]] returns in [[Containment]] alongside [[Ramiel]], coming in when the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] is defeated to steal its [[God Cube]] fragment before escaping through the portal. [[Kronus]] made his second appearance in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], where he and [[Marcellus]] ventured into the [[Frost Realm]] to wake up the [[Frost Spirit]] from its castle, using the [[God Cube]] fragment they had in their possession to mind control it into their bidding, beckoning it to destroy the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. He makes his last appearance in the [[Null & Void Event]], joining his brothers in fighting the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] to free [[Lord Exo]]. But once their plans succeed, and [[Lord Exo]] is freed, he steals his body, ripping the soul out from it to incarnate into his true form. It is likely that [[Kronus]] is now dead. ==Story== ===Halloween 2020=== [[Trick or Threat Town]] after the fight between [[Lord Sinister]] and the [[T.D.S. Organization]] is now in ruins. With its reputation destroyed, its citizens were forced to abandon their former home.{{InlineQuote|[[Lord Sinister|Sinister]] destroyed our town's reputation after you left, but that's when we've discovered a shard — along with this clown. Our people left the town and were forced to abandon everything. You claim to be heroes, but you saved no one.|[[Kronus]] on Wave 29 ([[Blind Faith]])}} Three of these citizens were brothers, [[Kronus]], [[Ramiel]] and [[Marcellus]]. On their way out of the town, they encountered a shard alongside the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]], who promised them that [[Lord Exo]] could bring back the town to its former glory. While never explicitly stated to be the start of the '''Children of Exo''' it is heavily likely the cult was former around this time.{{InlineQuote|When [[Trick or Threat Town]] was attacked, three brothers were saved by TDS from [[Lord Sinister]]. But the Town’s reputation was destroyed- some said it was too dangerous to visit. As the brothers left, [[Kronus]] found a [[God Cube|God]] Shard that was left behind, along with [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]]. That’s when [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] promised that [[Lord Exo]] would rebuild the town, and the brothers could live together once more.|[[Kronus]]' description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} As [[Kronus]]' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] only mentions three brothers{{InlineQuote|When [[Trick or Threat Town]] was attacked, three brothers were saved by TDS from [[Lord Sinister]].|[[Kronus]]' description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} and the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] refers to [[Kronus]], [[Ramiel]] and [[Marcellus]] as brothers{{InlineQuote|You and your brothers are weak, I'm unimpressed.|[[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] to the '''Children of Exo''' in the first [[Blind Faith]] cutscene}}, [[Titus]] is not actually one of the brothers. Therefore, it is unclear when he actually joined the '''Children of Exo'''. ===Between Halloween 2020 – Lunar Overture=== The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] leads the [[Children of Exo]] to the Temple of Exo. Afterwards, he agrees to help them rebuild the [[God Cube]].{{InlineQuote|You USED me, to bring you to the Temple of Exo! THEN you scheming JERKS made me put together your [[God Cube|GOD CUBE]] PIECES before throwing me to the Executioner!|[[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] to [[Titus]] in the first [[Banlands]] cutscene}} ===Hexscape=== ====Night 1==== The '''Children of Exo''' attempt to open a portal to the [[Nil Zone]], but they are detected by T.D.S. [[Titus]] decides to stall for time by fighting the T.D.S. agents so the portal can finish activation. When [[Titus]] is defeated, the portal finishes its activation, sucking him and the agents into [[The Nightmare Realm|Hex Realm]]. ====Night 2==== While not shown on screen, the other cultists also entered the dimension. The foreign presence inside the realm angers the [[Conserver]]{{InlineQuote|You and the hooded figure before have no place there.|[[Conserver (Narrator)|Conserver]] on Wave 17}}, causing him to attack the T.D.S. Agents. The discharge of corrupted energy from the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]]'s release causes [[Titus]] to become corrupted. ====Night 3==== While T.D.S. fights off the hordes of enemies in [[Containment]], [[Titus]] returns as [[Corrupted Titus]] and then is defeated. After the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] is vanquished, the '''Children of Exo''' swoop in at the last second to take the [[God Cube]] fragment it hosted. They escaped back through the portal. ===Operation I.C.E=== [[Ramiel]] infiltrates [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] disguised as a janitor, later entering a control room so he can open a portal to the [[Frost Realm]]. After opening it, the Frost Army begins invading the outpost. Near the end of the invasion, the '''Children of Exo''' unleash the [[Frost Spirit]] to attack [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. After the [[Frost Spirit]] is defeated, [[Ramiel]] escapes [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. During this event, [[Kronus]] is seen holding a staff which heavily resembles the one wielded by [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] during the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. While never directly stated to be the same staff, it can actually perform ice attack as seen in the [[Null & Void Event]], suggesting it is the same staff. As the game never shows or tells when they obtained this staff, it is unclear when they would have gotten it. The two most plausible options are either during the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]] or it was stolen while [[Ramiel]] was working at [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. ===Between Operation I.C.E – Null & Void=== '''Children of Exo''' search for more [[God Cube]] fragments, resulting in them acquiring around half of the shards.[[Kronus]]' staff is seen having a partial [[God Cube]] in it, which allows him to merge it with the half that the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] took from the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. ===Null & Void=== ====Night 2==== [[Titus]] is sent to the [[Banlands]], where he is then captured by the [[Null Guardian (Story)|Null Guardian]]. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] screams at [[Titus]] inside the [[Nil Zone]], saying that the '''Children of Exo''' used him to lead them to the "''Temple of Exo''", then throwing him to the "''Executioner''" once he had fulfilled his purpose. ====Night 3==== [[Ramiel]], [[Marcellus]], and [[Kronus]] are seen in [[Blind Faith]] fighting the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], who both appear to be fighting over the half of the [[God Cube]] each side possesses. The [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] restrains the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], and [[Kronus]] reunifies the [[God Cube]] whole again, beginning the process of transferring [[Lord Exo]]'s soul from the [[God Cube]] into the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]]'s body. However, [[Lord Exo]] could not get the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] to relinquish control of the body, so he removes [[Kronus]]' soul and uses his body to incarnate into his true form. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Titus}} Titus.png|[[Titus]] in game.
